seo.title: AI Automation: Stop Re-typing, Start Reviewing
seo.description: Automate invoices, orders, reports and customer requests with AI and connected tools. Tested on your own data, with human review where it matters.

hero.title: Your team should not be re-typing data.
hero.lead: We automate the repetitive work between your tools (invoices, orders, reports, customer requests) by connecting them and using AI, with a person reviewing anything uncertain.
bullets: Free review of one process you want to automate
Tested on your real documents before going live
Works with French, Arabic and English documents
hero.whatsappMessage: Hello Atlaxys, I would like to automate a process in my business.

problem.title: Where the hours go
points: Invoices and receipts typed into accounting software by hand
Orders arriving on WhatsApp and email, copied into spreadsheets
Weekly reports put together by hand from several tools
Errors discovered weeks later, when they cost more to fix

solution.title: Automation with safeguards
solution.text: We connect your tools, add AI where the information is unstructured, and keep people in control with review steps and activity logs.

points.title: Document reading
points.text: Invoices, receipts, forms and scans turned into checked, structured data.

points.title: Request routing
points.text: Messages sorted and sent to the right person, with the context they need.

points.title: Automatic reports
points.text: Figures gathered from all your tools into one report, on schedule.

points.title: Connected tools
points.text: Your CRM, management, accounting and messaging tools sharing data with each other.

items.title: Measured, not promised
items.text: We measure accuracy on a sample of your own documents before switching anything on.

items.title: People stay in control
items.text: Anything the system is unsure about goes to a person for review.

items.title: Your data stays protected
items.text: A setup designed around data protection rules, with only the necessary data sent to AI services.

proof.title: How we show it works
proof.text: You should not have to take our word for it. Every automation project includes:

items.title: A test on your own documents
items.text: Accuracy measured on a sample of your real documents, shared with you before anything goes live.

items.title: A pilot first
items.text: One process and one team, running alongside your current way of working until the results hold up.

items.title: A full activity log
items.text: You can see what was automated, why, and who approved it.

steps.title: Tell us about the process
steps.text: Which task takes the most time? Two minutes in the form.

steps.title: Free review call
steps.text: We map the process and estimate the time you could save.

steps.title: Pilot
steps.text: One process automated and measured on your real data.

steps.title: Extend
steps.text: Move on to the next process once the first one has proved itself.

items.question: Do we need to change our software?
items.answer: Usually not. We connect to the tools you already use, through their APIs (built-in connections), exports or email.

items.question: Is AI accurate enough?
items.answer: For many types of documents, yes. But we check it on your own data first, and keep a human review step for uncertain cases.

items.question: Is our data used to train AI?
items.answer: We use AI services and settings that do not use your data for training, and we document how your data is handled.
